_readme: Holiday gift guide (Hank, Nov 6, 2026: fun but useful). Amazon search links only (no specific listings or prices, which change); the build adds the Associates tag. Live reader deals from data/deals.json show automatically. Refresh picks each November.
title: Gifts for 4x4 owners: 30 ideas for the boxy-truck person in your life
seo_title: Gifts for 4x4 Owners: 30 Ideas for Off-Road & Overland Fans (2026)
description: Gift ideas for Land Cruiser, Jeep, G-Wagen, Defender and 4Runner owners: recovery gear, air compressors, garage tools, camp kit, LEGO sets, books and stocking stuffers, picked by owners.
lead: Picked by people who own these trucks: the gear that actually gets used, the stuff that makes a Saturday in the garage easier, and a few things that are just fun. No gadgets that end up in a drawer.

groups.title: For getting unstuck
groups.lead: The kit every trail truck should carry and most don't.

items.name: Recovery traction boards
items.why: Wedge them under the tires in sand, mud or snow and drive out. The single most-used piece of recovery gear.

items.name: Soft shackles and a kinetic recovery rope
items.q: kinetic recovery rope soft shackle kit
items.why: Lighter and safer than steel shackles and a tow strap. Check the rope's rating against the truck's weight.

items.name: Hitch receiver shackle mount
items.why: Turns the tow hitch into a proper rated recovery point. Never recover from a tow ball.

items.name: Tree saver strap and gloves
items.why: Protects the tree and the winch line. Cheap, and almost nobody buys one for themselves.

items.name: Folding shovel
items.why: For digging out an axle or a buried tire before you reach for the winch.

groups.title: For airing down (and back up)
groups.lead: Dropping tire pressure is the cheapest capability upgrade there is. Getting it back up is the hard part.

items.name: Portable 12V air compressor
items.why: Airs four big tires back up before the pavement. Get one rated for continuous duty.

items.name: Automatic tire deflators
items.why: Screw on, set the pressure once, and all four stop at the same number.

items.name: Digital tire pressure gauge
items.why: Accurate at low pressures, where cheap stick gauges guess.

items.name: Tire plug kit
items.why: Fixes a trail puncture in ten minutes. Stocking-stuffer price.

groups.title: For the garage
groups.lead: These trucks reward owners who do their own work. Our repair guides list the tools for every job.

items.name: Bluetooth OBD-II scanner
items.why: Reads and clears codes from a phone. Only for 1996 and newer trucks; older ones don't have OBD-II.

items.name: Torque wrench
items.why: Wheel nuts, axle and suspension bolts all have a torque spec. Guessing is how studs snap.

items.name: Rechargeable work light
items.why: Hooks or sticks anywhere under the truck. You'll use it every weekend.

items.name: Rolling creeper
items.why: Your back will thank you on the first oil change.

items.name: Rust-prevention undercoating
items.why: Old ladder frames rot from the inside. A yearly coat of a wax or lanolin spray is cheap insurance.

items.name: A factory service manual
items.why: The best gift for a new owner. Every truck guide on BoxyTrucks lists its manuals and where to find them.

groups.title: For the trip
groups.lead: For the owner who keeps saying they'll take it camping this year.

items.name: Rechargeable headlamp
items.why: Hands-free light for a night-time tire change or setting up camp.

items.name: 12V fridge freezer
items.why: No more ice in the cooler. A big gift, but the one overlanders talk about most.

items.name: Folding camp chairs
items.why: Every trail day ends sitting down.

items.name: First-aid kit
items.why: The thing everyone means to put in the truck and doesn't.

items.name: Insulated mug
items.why: Coffee that stays hot on a cold morning start. Low risk, always used.

groups.title: Just for fun
groups.lead: For the person who already has the gear.

items.name: LEGO Land Rover Defender
items.why: LEGO has made both the classic Defender 90 and the new one. A weekend of building for the Land Rover person.

items.name: LEGO Mercedes G-Class
items.why: The Technic G 500 has working suspension and steering. G-Wagen owners love it.

items.name: LEGO Jeep Wrangler
items.why: A small, cheap Technic Wrangler. A good stocking stuffer for a Jeep family.

items.name: Diecast models
items.why: Search their exact truck: Land Cruisers, Broncos, Defenders and Scouts all come in 1:24 and 1:18.

items.name: Coffee-table books
items.why: There are good histories of the Land Cruiser, the Defender, the G-Wagen and the Jeep. Swap the search for their truck.

items.name: Microfiber towels
items.why: Glass, dash, dipsticks. You can never have too many.

items.name: Valve stem caps and a core tool
items.why: For airing down fast and replacing the caps that always go missing.

items.name: Ratchet straps
items.why: For the roof rack, the bed, the trailer, everything.

items.name: Zip ties and electrical tape
items.why: Half of all trail repairs. Seriously.

items.name: Paint thickness gauge
items.why: For the friend who's shopping for a truck: it finds filler and resprays in seconds. Pair it with our free inspection checklist.
